name: Abbott India Ltd
about: Abbott India Ltd is one of the leading multinational pharmaceutical companies in India and sells its products through independent distributors primarily within India.[1] It was established in 1944.[2]
keyPoints: Abbott Group:[1] The company is a part of Abbott Laboratories, USA which has a presence in 160 countries with leading medical devices, diagnostics, nutrition products, and branded generic medicines.
pros: Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 34.9%
Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 77.9%
cons: Stock is trading at 13.0 times its book value
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 9.96% over past five years.
